# Phyto Thrive Labs

> Phyto Thrive Labs is a Brain Health & Cognitive Wellness Supplement. Phytomem One is a once-daily dietary supplement from Phyto Thrive Labs designed to support brain health, memory, and cognitive wellness. It comes in capsule form and is intended to be taken as part of a daily routine to help maintain mental clarity and focus. The formula is positioned for adults looking to support their cognitive function as they age.
